newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kookmin Bank $200m sub FRN group forms.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin Bank $200m sub FRN group forms.

text.p: A syndicate group has formed for Kookmin Bank's US$200 million subordinated 144a floating rate note issue, the joint bookrunners said on Monday.

The 10-year subordinated notes were launched at par and re-offered at 99.872 on Monday morning. They pay a quarterly coupon of 60 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) for years one through five and LIBOR plus 185 basis points thereafter.

Earlier on Monday, the bookrunners said the coupon would be set over three months but then revised it to six months in a statement after the group had been formed. The listing also was changed from London to Luxembourg.
The re-offer yield is LIBOR plus 63 basis points payable quarterly for years one through five and LIBOR plus 122.5 basis points for years one through 10.

Chase Manhattan Asia and Merrill Lynch Far East are joint lead managers and joint bookrunners. Co-lead managers are BA Asia, Bankers Trust Co, Fuji International Finance (HK), Sakura Finance Asia and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK).
The notes are free to trade as of 5 p.m. Hong Kong time (0900 GMT). The payment date is December 30.
